known_patches: Integer identity schemas and synthetic source persona
Original source semantics bounded by actual probes
limitations: Only Person.isFavourite changes and saved-search Album record creation/deletion certified; no separate Person rename input exists. Stored searchQuery JSON is not certified as full search evaluation.

Original Album delete guards are admin OR unlocked alternatives; admin deletes locked album and this is explicitly probed. Person update only checks authentication and existing name; viewer role 1 can change favourite flag.

Media caption is genuine readable text through gallery_get_media, whose mediaPath matches name rather than directory/path. No binary read/upload, scanner/job, extension installation, settings write or networking executed.
Sharing key/expiry/timestamp source values are placeholder strings; no functional secret generation/expiry/password sharing claim.
